notes: The Secretary of State's results site, linked from its Election Results page (https://www.sos.arkansas.gov/elections/research/election-results); read through its keyless data service (https://enr-results-api.totalresults.com/, client arkansas): the election, its contest list, each county's results with its precinct rows (states_cache/ar_local/results/20221108/tally/county/), and the contest-wide results of every contest shown in more than one county (contest/). Every answer is marked isOfficial; the service's lastUpdated is 2025-12-16T20:01:52.3236434Z (the Secretary moved its past elections to this vendor's service in December 2025). The SHA-256 is of the contest list; every file is kept.
gaps: The county printed this contest with a single 'FOR' line and no candidate's name (an unopposed candidate's line); its votes are not joined to anyone, so it is not stored.
The county printed this contest with a single 'FOR' line and no candidate's name (an unopposed candidate's line); its votes are not joined to anyone, so it is not stored.

Arkansas prints an unopposed candidate on the general election ballot only for a few offices (the State Board of Election Commissioners' County Board manual); the rest are declared elected without a vote, so those offices are not in the results.
Runoffs four weeks after the general election

A county or city office where nobody had more than half the votes went to a runoff four weeks later (the State Board of Election Commissioners' County Board manual). The results service does not hold those runoffs, so those contests have no winner marked here.
Votes by how they were cast, and most parties

The results service gives each precinct's total only, not Election Day, early, absentee and provisional votes, and it marks only Republican and Democratic candidates. Other parties are given only where a county typed a code before the name or, for President and Congress, from the Clerk of the House's statistics. The Secretary of State posts no other file for 2022 on its Election Results page.
